Historical Description
The Umayyad–Byzantine Wars were a series of monumental conflicts between 661 and 750 AD.
Umayyad Strategy
The Umayyad military was known for its massive land and naval offensives. Under Caliphs like Muawiya I, the Arab navy was built to challenge Byzantine dominance in the Mediterranean. Commanders like Maslama led historical sieges against Constantinople.
Byzantine Defense
The Byzantines, led by emperors like Leo III, used the famous "Greek Fire" to protect their capital. While they lost territories in North Africa, they successfully defended their heartland in Anatolia.
